Identifying store-layer entity types and counting how many external packages reference each.

The data layer appears to be the `store` package, containing entities such as User, Memo, and Attachment.

I am identifying the main persistent entity types in the `store` package, including User, Memo, Attachment, Reaction, and Inbox. I will count how many packages outside `store/` reference each type.

I am expanding the list of persistent entity types to include IdentityProvider, MemoRelation, MemoShare, UserIdentity, UserSetting, and InstanceSetting. I will exclude generated Find* and Update* helpers. The next step is to run a script that counts distinct external Go packages referencing each entity type.

args.command:
ROOT=/bench/repo
# Persistent entity types (table-mapped structs in store/)
ENTITIES="User Memo Attachment Reaction Inbox IdentityProvider MemoRelation MemoShare UserIdentity UserSetting InstanceSetting"

> /tmp/entity_pkg_counts.txt
for ent in $ENTITIES; do
  > /tmp/pkgset_${ent}.txt
  # Find files outside store/ referencing store.Entity or *store.Entity or []store.Entity etc.
  grep -rl "store\.${ent}\b" $(find $ROOT -name "*.go" ! -name "*_test.go" ! -path "*/proto/gen/*" ! -path "*/store/*" ! -path "*/web/*") 2>/dev/null | while read f; do
    pkg=$(grep '^package ' "$f" | head -1 | awk '{print $2}')
    dir=${f#$ROOT/}
    dir=$(dirname "$dir")
    echo "${dir}::${pkg}" >> /tmp/pkgset_${ent}.txt
  done
  count=$(sort -u /tmp/pkgset_${ent}.txt | wc -l)
  echo "$count $ent"
  sort -u /tmp/pkgset_${ent}.txt | head -5
  echo "---"
done | tee /tmp/entity_pkg_counts.txt
sort -rn /tmp/entity_pkg_counts.txt | head -10
